idea-plugin.name: GitLab MR Pipelines
idea-plugin.description:
Pipeline status of your open GitLab merge requests (gitlab.com or self-hosted) right in the IDE — no more refreshing a browser tab to see whether CI passed.

  • Tool window with your open MRs and their pipeline status; sort, group by project / branch, choose columns.
  • MRs you authored, optionally also those assigned to you or awaiting your review.
  • Optional history of the last 10 pipelines per MR.
  • Filter to the current project, or to the current project and checked-out git branch.
  • Pipeline start time and duration columns.
  • Status bar widget with the failed-pipeline count and notifications when a pipeline fails or succeeds.
  • GraphQL API with REST fallback; token kept in the IDE Password Safe; IDE proxy and certificates respected.

Setup:

  1. Create a GitLab Personal Access Token with the read_api scope.
  2. Open Settings → Tools → GitLab MR Pipelines, enter the GitLab URL and the token, click the connection test.
  3. Open the GitLab Pipelines tool window.

Documentation: README on GitHub.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0

  • The whole UI is now in English.
  • New filter: All merge requests / Current project / Current project and branch (follows git checkout).
  • New Started, Duration and Finished columns.
  • Distinct toolbar icons for Filter, Group By and Columns.
  • Recent pipeline refs shown as “MR !881” / “MR !881 (merged result)”.
  • Settings: the token hint no longer widens the page; a “Create token” link instead of the full URL.

1.1.0

  • Tree table with grouping by project, branch, or project and branch.
  • Sort by any column; column chooser with reorder and resize, all persisted. New Role and Pipeline columns.
  • “Current project only” filter based on the IDE project's git remotes.
  • “Show all pipelines”: the last 10 pipelines of each MR as child rows.
  • Fixed: the Status column showed MergeRequest(...) instead of the status icon and label.

Full history: CHANGELOG.
